Delivered key system upgrades and operational milestone, strengthening our role in critical transportation infrastructure
Transportation Solutions
•Completed a network upgrade supporting the OCTOPUS PROCESSING SYSTEM for the MTR 
bus fleet, strengthening reliability for one of Hong Kong’s largest transit payment ecosystems.
•Installed modern communication systems — including surveillance, telephony, and network 
equipment — for the MTR’S NEW INTEGRATED WHEELSET MAINTENANCE CENTRE , 
improving operational safety and efficiency.
•Completed factory acceptance for the new In -train TV system, covering more than 350 servers 
and controllers to be deployed across the AIRPORT EXPRESS LINE  and TUNG CHUNG LINE .
•Finalised  system development and factory testing for HONG KONG INTERNATIONAL 
AIRPORT ’s project for upgrading industrial controllers for more than 1,100 digital displays.
•Awarded the Universal Training platform for MTR’S NEW LINE EXTENSIONS , enabling more 
efficient workforce training across multiple systems.
•Completed factory testing for MTR’S DEPOT DIGITAL MAP SYSTEM , supporting smoother 
depot operations and asset visibility.
•Completed major design work and site surveys for SRT’S FIBRE -OPTIC PROJECT
•Installed a video -analytics system for crow detection at BANGKOK AIRPORT  to support more 
smooth operation.
